system.description:
This ability lets the Sielanic practitioner draw upon the power latent in the earth to enhance her own physical abilities, so long as she remains in contact with the soil.

System: The vampire cuts the soles of her feet and lets her blood soak into the naked earth. The successes gained on a Willpower roll determine the number of points she may add to her Physical Attributes (no single Attribute may exceed 5). The effect lasts one scene and covers roughly 50 feet around the point where the blood first touched the soil.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Two: Usurpers
system.prerequisites: Sielanic Thaumaturgy: Path of the World's Blood; must be attuned to the land
